Welcome to my professional portfolio.

title: PROJECTS
text:
This page highlights selected academic projects from my analytics coursework at Boston University. These projects demonstrate my growing technical skills in cloud computing, big data processing, machine learning, data visualization, and professional portfolio development.


PySpark AWS EC2 Machine Learning Seaborn Quarto
Built salary prediction models using a large Lightcast job postings dataset. Compared generalized linear regression, polynomial regression, and random forest models using RMSE, MAE, R², AIC, and BIC.
Key skills: feature engineering, model evaluation, polynomial features, random forest feature importance, diagnostic visualization.



Python Plotly Seaborn Data Visualization Job Market Analysis
Created visualizations to explore labor market patterns, technical skill demand, and AI-related job trends. The project focused on turning large-scale job posting data into clear visual insights for business audiences.
Key skills: exploratory data analysis, visual storytelling, chart design, job market trend analysis, insight communication.



AWS EC2 VS Code Python GitHub Quarto
Configured a cloud-based analytics environment using AWS EC2. Set up a virtual machine, connected through VS Code, installed required Python packages, and prepared the environment for reproducible analytics work.
Key skills: cloud setup, remote development, virtual environments, Git/GitHub workflow, reproducible analytics.



Quarto GitHub Pages HTML CSS Professional Portfolio
Built this personal portfolio website using Quarto and GitHub Pages. The website presents my background, academic projects, CV, and contact information in a clear and professional format.
Key skills: website development, portfolio organization, GitHub Pages deployment, professional branding.

title: ABOUT ME
text:
I am Hye Won Kim, a strategy, operations, and analytics professional based in Boston, Massachusetts.
I have 10+ years of experience across technology, market expansion, business operations, and data-driven decision-making. Most recently, I served as Chief of Staff to the CEO at Blind, where I supported growth strategy, KPI reporting, investor-facing materials, and cross-functional execution for U.S. and India expansion initiatives.
I am currently pursuing an M.S. in Applied Business Analytics at Boston University. Through my coursework, I am building stronger technical skills in analytics, forecasting, cloud computing, data engineering, machine learning, and data visualization.


My interests sit at the intersection of business strategy and analytics. I am especially interested in using data to understand growth opportunities, improve business operations, and support better decision-making.



My goal is to continue building a career in data-driven business strategy, operations, and analytics. I am interested in roles where I can combine my business background with technical skills in Python, SQL, cloud computing, and data visualization.
